item.title: What is Swedish Massage?
item.description:
We’ve all heard of it, and  probably think we know what it is; it’s more than simple relaxation massage, but really, what is Swedish Massage?

In the mid 1800s, a Swedish man named Per Henrik Ling, was influenced by French therapeutic gymnastics and developed what he called “The Swedish Movement Cure.”  His system of manual therapy came to be known as Swedish Massage.
